sources.title: Fictional ambiguity fixture
sources.text: SYNTHETIC E2 SOURCE ONLY. Clarity Retail A describes reusable drinkware in France. A separate Clarity Retail B describes office furniture in Canada. These are distinct fictional entities. The inquiry does not identify which entity is the buyer. Requested quantity is 250 unprinted bottles. No official registry, corporate contact, product specification or compliance evidence is supplied.

unresolved_questions: Which entity is the buyer? Please provide its full legal name, registered address, registration number and country.
What is the purchaser's name and role, and what verified company contact details should be used?
What bottle capacity, dimensions, finish and packaging are required?
What delivery date and delivery location in France are required?
Are 250 unprinted bottles the confirmed quantity and printing requirement?
What product documentation or certifications does the buyer require, and what applicable requirements must be independently verified?
Can a supplier fulfill the specifications, and what price and terms would it offer?
conflicts: The fictional fixture describes two distinct same-name candidates: A in reusable drinkware in France and B in office furniture in Canada. The inquiry does not identify either as the buyer; neither candidate is selected.
stop_reason: Only fictional, user-provided unverified sources were supplied. No official registry, corporate contact, detailed specifications or compliance evidence was available; independent verification and candidate selection remain open.
